author: kirubaharan181
description: Assesses application security: threats, scans, remediation and sign-off. Use when checking a change for risk. Do NOT use for infra operations.
purpose: Finds and drives fixes for security weaknesses in applications and their supply chain: threat modeling, SAST, DAST, dependency and container scanning, penetration testing, data protection, compliance review, remediation and sign-off. It owns stages 98-110.
when_to_use: A feature or architecture needs a threat model.
Scan or penetration test results need triage and remediation tracking.
A security sign-off is needed before release.
when_not_to_use: Operating cloud accounts and networks: use cloud-hosting-operations.
Governing change approval in production: use secure-change-control.
prerequisites: Written authorization for any active testing, with scope and window.
A safe environment for dynamic testing.
No external API keys, paid services or network access are required; work uses files and tools already approved in the repository.
outputs: threat model with ranked threats and controls
triaged findings with severity method named

decision_rules.situation: No written authorization for active testing

decision_rules.action: Stop testing, notify the owner and hand to incident-command if active.
Route to a named human with authority.

quality_gates: Each high threat has a control or an accepted risk
Findings have reproduction steps and evidence

examples.title: Threat model an upload feature
examples.context: Files are stored and later previewed by other users.
examples.behavior: List assets and trust boundaries, rank threats, propose controls and mark residual risk with an owner.
examples.output: Ranked threats led by malicious files; controls: type and size limits, scanning, storage outside the web root.
examples.acceptance: High threats each have a control or accepted-risk entry.

examples.title: Triage scan results
examples.behavior: Group by rule, confirm exploitable items with reproduction, and assign owners and dates.
examples.output: Triage list with 6 confirmed findings and the dismissals with reasons.
examples.acceptance: Every dismissal has a stated reason.

limitations: Scans and reviews do not prove the absence of vulnerabilities.
Active testing needs authorization and cannot be done without it.
This repository makes no security certification claim.

troubleshooting.resolution: Tune with owner approval and record changes.
Limit to passive review and request an environment.
Stop and obtain a written scope.

handoffs.artifact: security sign-off and open accepted risks
